title: Four-bar crank-rocker: one linkage, three engines, three strength checks
question: Does this linkage turn a full crank revolution into a rocker swing, with enough transmission angle and enough strength, and do three physics engines reading the same X3D file agree with the closed form?
label: A worked study. Not a certified design and not for manufacture.

units.frame: X3D: right-handed, y up; the mechanism lies in the xy plane and turns about +z

a.what: crank, pin A to pin B

b.what: coupler, pin B to pin C

c.what: rocker, pin D to pin C

d.what: ground link, pin A to pin D

T_out.what: resisting torque on the rocker, either direction, held at every crank angle (quasi-static)

Fy.source: ASTM A36/A36M, 36 ksi [250 MPa] for plates, bars and shapes under 8 in thick. Read from a search summary on 27 Nov 2026, not from the standard: Likely

E.source: textbook value (29,000 ksi in AISC 360): Likely, from memory

FS.what: factor of safety on every strength check
FS.source: study allowable, chosen on this card. No code governs this mechanism

requirements.shall: The linkage shall be a Grashof crank-rocker: shortest plus longest link no longer than the other two, with the crank the shortest link. In the claimed envelope the crank shall complete at least 2 full revolutions in every qualifying engine.
At every crank speed in the claimed envelope, at least two independent engines shall hold the rocker angle to the closed-form rocker angle for the measured crank angle.
The transmission angle shall stay between 45 and 135 degrees over the whole revolution.
requirements.source: 45 degrees as the floor for transmitting force: University of Arkansas open text 'Mechanism Posture and Position Analysis' (search summary, Likely). Other texts say 40.

requirements.shall: With T_out applied in either direction at every crank angle, demand shall not exceed capacity on coupler yield, coupler Euler buckling and pin double shear, each with FS.
At every crank speed in the claimed envelope, at least two independent engines shall keep every pin closed.
requirements.check: max pin gap in the plane

requirements.shall: At every crank speed in the claimed envelope, at least two independent engines shall keep every bar end in its own layer.
requirements.check: max travel of any bar end out of its z layer

references.what: rocker and coupler angle by circle intersection
Newton on the vector loop equation, started 0.05 rad off
power balance: crank torque from statics times crank speed equals T_out times rocker speed
velocity ratios against a central difference of the closed form
three engines stepping one X3D RigidBodyPhysics file: built-in, Rapier 0.21.0, cannon-es 0.20.0

envelope.what: initial crank speed at 60 degrees; the linkage then coasts with no gravity, so the engine check is purely kinematic. The claim is made only where at least two engines qualify; the probes are run and reported, never gated.

scene_mutants.what: the scene's coupler is 2 % long; the card is unchanged
crank 0.65 m: shortest plus longest exceeds the other two
crank 0.40 m: the transmission angle dips under 45 degrees
all four pins are SingleAxisHingeJoints. X3D 4.0 clause 37.4.12 stops a hinge pi radians from its initial position, so an engine that follows the standard cannot turn the crank

analysis_mutants.what: compare the engines with the other assembly branch of the closed form
rocker velocity ratio with its sign flipped
Newton solver given a rocker 1 mm long

exchange.format: X3D 4.0 RigidBodyPhysics, read by the x3d.loom bridge reader
exchange.identity: DEF names Crank, Coupler, Rocker, Frame, PinA to PinD

exploration.when: 27 Nov 2026, before the limits below were written
exploration.rig: Node v22.23.5, x3d.loom bridge reader at 4a8dcd2, Rapier 0.21.0, cannon-es 0.20.0, 60 Hz samples of a 240 Hz step

columns: bar end out of plane mm

findings: With four SingleAxisHingeJoints the built-in engine stops the crank pi radians from its start (X3D 4.0 clause 37.4.12) while the Rapier and cannon-es adapters let it turn: the two full-turn pins became BallJoints.

A ball pin whose anchor is 10 mm off the crank's own axis lets the crank's free spin drag the mechanism out of plane (bar ends up to 10 mm out at 1 rad/s in every engine): the anchors were moved onto the axis.
Worst case: speed. Every engine degrades with crank speed; at 30 rad/s none keeps the bars in their layers.
exploration.honesty: The run of record is the same deterministic computation as this exploration, so the limits were written with these numbers in view. Each limit is therefore derived from function, with its derivation stated, and the thinnest margin (cannon-es, bar end out of plane at 1 rad/s) is flagged for a second reader.

rocker_error_deg.why: 0.5 degrees is 6.1 mm at the tip of the 0.7 m rocker, the positioning tolerance asked of the output

pin_gap_mm.why: one eighth of the 8 mm pin: beyond that the pin has left its hole

out_of_plane_mm.why: half of the 10 mm face gap between neighbouring bar layers (layers 20 mm apart, bars 10 mm thick), so two neighbours cannot touch

min_engines.why: a claim needs two independent implementations (law 25)

utilisation.why: R4, with FS already inside the capacity

newton_vs_closed_rad.why: REF2: two routes to the same angles

velocity_ratio_vs_difference.why: REF5, central difference with h = 1e-5 rad

hinge_travel_rad.why: control: pi plus a 0.06 rad allowance for a soft stop; an engine past this ignored the standard's hinge stop

amendments.after: the run of record of 27-28 Nov and the adapter change in x3d.physics/rigid-engines
amendments.what: Two gates added on the four-hinge control. hinge-stop-is-said: every engine that lets the default-range hinge travel past the limit names clause 37.4.12 in its notes. hinge-stop-x3d-option: with use({ hingeStop: 'x3d' }) all three engines keep the hinge within limits.hinge_travel_rad, a limit that was on the card before.
amendments.why: The first run found the adapters dropped the stop without a note. The ODE user guide, read afterwards, shows the adapters follow ODE's convention (a stop at exactly pi is not effective), so the honest state is two readings, each now stated by the engine that takes it.
